tools.name: bm_context
tools.title: Build context
tools.description: Follow the Basic Memory knowledge graph from a note: the note, its observations, and the notes its relations reach, up to `depth` hops (1-5). `identifier` is a path, permalink, memory:// URL, or a pattern such as 'specs/*'. `since` limits related results to recent changes. `compact` returns the graph without note bodies; read chosen notes with bm_read.

identifier.description: Where to start: a note path, permalink, memory:// URL, or a pattern such as 'specs/*'.

since.description: How far back to look: '7d', '24h', '2 days ago', 'last week', or a date. Windows shorter than one day are widened to one day.

compact.description: Omit note bodies and observations; keep the graph shape.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_delete
tools.title: Delete note
tools.description: Delete a Basic Memory note (`identifier`) or a directory (`path`). A directory delete removes every file under it and needs `recursive=true`. Pass `expected_checksum` (from bm_read) to delete a note only if it is still the revision you read. A note that does not exist is an error. This cannot be undone.

identifier.description: The note to delete: a path, permalink, memory:// URL or exact title.

path.description: The directory to delete, with everything in it.

recursive.description: Required true to delete a directory and everything under it.

expected_checksum.description: Delete the note only while it is still this revision (from bm_read).

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_edit
tools.title: Edit note
tools.description: Change part of an existing Basic Memory note. `command`: append or prepend `content`; find_replace `find_text` with `content` (exact text, which must occur `expected_replacements` times, default 1); replace_section, insert_before_section or insert_after_section for a `section` heading ('Decisions', 'Auth/Decisions', 'Decisions[1]', as bm_read takes it); set_metadata to merge `metadata` into the frontmatter without touching the body. `metadata` also merges with any other command. Pass `expected_checksum` (from bm_read) to edit only the revision you read. A missing note is an error; create notes with bm_write.

identifier.description: The note or file: a file path ('notes/plan.md'), permalink, memory:// URL, exact title, external id, or '<project>/path'.

content.description: The text to add or the replacement. Not used by set_metadata.

section.description: The heading for section commands: "Decisions", "Auth/Decisions" for one under "Auth", or "Decisions[1]" for the second of two.

find_text.description: For find_replace: the exact, case-sensitive text to replace.

expected_replacements.description: For find_replace: how many times find_text must occur.

replace_subsections.description: For replace_section: true replaces the section's subsections too; false stops at the first subsection heading.

metadata.description: Frontmatter fields to set; other fields are kept.

expected_checksum.description: Edit only while the note is still this revision (from bm_read).

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_find
tools.title: Find files
tools.description: Find files in a Basic Memory project, recursively. With `name`, match file names against a glob ('*meeting*'). With `filters`, match notes by frontmatter, e.g. {"status": "active"} or {"priority": {"$in": ["high"]}}, and with `fields` return just those frontmatter values per note. `path` limits the search to a folder. For ranked text or meaning search, use bm_search.

path.description: A directory in the project, e.g. 'specs' or 'specs/active'. '/' is the project root; '<project>/path' addresses another project.

filters.description: Frontmatter filters as {field: condition}. Nested fields use dot notation ("schema.confidence"). A condition is a value for equality ({"status": "draft"}), null for absent-or-null ({"owner": null}), a list for contains-all ({"tags": ["a", "b"]}), or an operator object with $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $between, $contains or $exists, e.g. {"priority": {"$in": ["high"]}}. Several operators on one field AND together.

fields.description: Frontmatter fields to return per note (dot paths allowed), e.g. ["title", "priority"]. Needs `filters`.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_list
tools.title: List folder
tools.description: List one folder of a Basic Memory project: its subfolders, then its files with title, date and id. `project` is required; '/' lists its root. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Filter files with `glob` and order them with `sort`. For a recursive search by name or frontmatter, use bm_find.

path.description: A directory in the project, e.g. 'specs' or 'specs/active'. '/' is the project root; '<project>/path' addresses another project.

sort.description: File order. Folders always come first.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_man
tools.title: Manual
tools.description: Read the Basic Memory manual. With no arguments, the index of every page. `page` reads one page: 'bm-search(3)' for an MCP tool, 'grep(1)' for a shell command; a tool name such as 'bm_search' works too. `query` lists the pages that mention every word given, like `man -k`.

page.description: The page to read, e.g. 'bm-search(3)', 'grep(1)' or 'bm_search'.

query.description: Words to find in the manual; lists the pages that mention them all.

tools.name: bm_move
tools.title: Move note
tools.description: Move or rename a Basic Memory note (`identifier`) or a directory (`path`) within its project. `destination` is the new project-relative path; ending it with '/' moves into that folder under the current name ('archive/'). A note keeps its file extension ('.markdown' may become '.md'). Pass `expected_checksum` (from bm_read) to move a note only if it is still the revision you read. Moving into another project is refused: bm_read, bm_write there, then bm_delete.

destination.description: New path, e.g. 'archive/plan.md'. A trailing '/' ('archive/') moves the note or directory into that folder under its current name.

identifier.description: The note to move: a path, permalink, memory:// URL or exact title.

path.description: The directory to move, with everything in it, e.g. 'drafts/2025'.

expected_checksum.description: Move the note only while it is still this revision (from bm_read).

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_schema
tools.title: Note schemas
tools.description: Basic Memory note schemas (Picoschema). `command`: validate notes against their schema (one `note_type`, one note by `identifier`, or every type that has a schema); infer a schema from the notes of a `note_type`; diff a `note_type`'s notes against its schema to find drift. A schema is a note with type: schema whose `entity` field names the note type it describes.

note_type.description: The frontmatter `type:` to check. Required for infer and diff.

identifier.description: For validate: one note, instead of a whole note type.

threshold.description: For infer: the share of notes a field must appear in to be suggested.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

anyOf.description: Full validation report for one or more notes.

items.description: Validation result for a single note against a schema.

passed.description: True if no errors (warnings are OK)

items.description: Result of validating a single schema field against a note.

unmatched_observations.description: Observation categories not covered by schema, with counts

unmatched_relations.description: Relation types not covered by schema

type_summaries.description: Per-type breakdown, populated when validating all schema-covered types

items.description: Per-type rollup used when validating all schema-covered types at once.

tools.name: bm_project
tools.title: Projects
tools.description: Basic Memory projects. `command`: list (projects, grouped by workspace); create (`name`, `path`, optional `set_default`, `workspace`); recent (what changed lately in the required `project`: `since`, `items`, paging).

name.description: For create: the new project's name.

path.description: For create: the folder that holds the project's notes.

set_default.description: For create: make the new project the default.

workspace.description: In Cloud: the workspace slug, name or id that holds the project.

since.description: How far back to look: '7d', '24h', '2 days ago', 'last week', or a date. Windows shorter than one day are widened to one day.

items.description: What to return: notes, observations, relations, or a mix. Default: notes.

project.description: Project name, 'workspace/project', or external id. Required for one-project operations; search may instead use `projects` or `all_projects=true`. Project discovery needs no scope.

tools.name: bm_search
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Search a Basic Memory project, ranked by relevance. `query` supports quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT and tag:name. `mode` picks hybrid (the default when semantic search is available), text, semantic, title or permalink (globs with *). Narrow with `filters` (frontmatter), `note_types`, `items` (notes, observations, relations) and `since`. `lines` returns the matching lines of each hit with that many lines of context, like grep. `path` limits the search to a folder; `identifier` searches one note. Scope every search with `project` (one project), `projects` (a list), or `all_projects=true`. Read full notes with bm_read.

query.description: What to search for. Omit to search by filters alone.

filters.description: Frontmatter filters as {field: condition}. Nested fields use dot notation ("schema.confidence"). A condition is a value for equality ({"status": "draft"}), null for absent-or-null ({"owner": null}), a list for contains-all ({"tags": ["a", "b"]}), or an operator object with $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $between, $contains or $exists, e.g. {"priority": {"$in": ["high"]}}. Several operators on one field AND together.

items.description: What to return: notes, observations, relations, or a mix. Default: notes.

categories.description: Observation categories to match exactly, e.g. ['decision'].

since.description: How far back to look: '7d', '24h', '2 days ago', 'last week', or a date. Windows shorter than one day are widened to one day.

lines.description: Return each hit's matching lines with this many lines of context (0-10), instead of a match excerpt.

max_matches.description: Matching lines shown per note with `lines`.

identifier.description: Search only this note; returns its matching lines.

path.description: Search only this folder and its subfolders.

compact.description: Omit note bodies and excerpts; keep identifiers and scores.

valid_at.description: Specialist: only facts whose authored valid time contains this date.

valid_overlaps.description: Specialist: only facts whose valid range overlaps '[start,end)'.

time_kind.description: Specialist: effective, valid, occurred, due or mentioned.

all_projects.description: Search every project you can access.

project.description: Project name, 'workspace/project', or external id. Required for one-project operations; search may instead use `projects` or `all_projects=true`. Project discovery needs no scope.

tools.name: bm_read
tools.title: Read note
tools.description: Read a Basic Memory note or file by path, permalink, memory:// URL or exact title. Slice a long note with `section` (a heading), `start_line`/`end_line` or `max_tokens`; line numbers count the whole file, frontmatter included. A text file such as .txt takes start_line/end_line too. `include_content=false` returns only the metadata and the checksum that bm_write and bm_edit take as expected_checksum. Images come back as images and other binary files as documents. A missing note is an error: find notes with bm_search.

identifier.description: The note or file: a file path ('notes/plan.md'), permalink, memory:// URL, exact title, external id, or '<project>/path'.

section.description: A heading to read: "Decisions", "Auth/Decisions" for a heading under "Auth", or "Decisions[1]" for the second "Decisions" heading.

max_tokens.description: Approximate token budget. Longer content is cut at a section or paragraph boundary, and the result says which line to continue from.

include_frontmatter.description: Include the YAML frontmatter in a whole-note read.

include_content.description: False returns only title, paths, checksum and updated_at.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.

tools.name: bm_write
tools.title: Write note
tools.description: Create or replace a Basic Memory note. Give a file path as `identifier` ('notes/plan.md'), or `title` plus `directory`. With a path the file lands exactly there and the title comes from the content's frontmatter, then `title`, then the file name. An existing note is an error unless `overwrite=true`; pass `expected_checksum` (from bm_read) to replace only the revision you read. To change part of a note use bm_edit. Content may hold frontmatter, observations ('- [category] fact #tag') and relations ('- relation_type [[Other Note]]').

content.description: The note's Markdown. Saved as given; it may start with frontmatter.

identifier.description: File path for the note, e.g. 'notes/plan.md'; '.md' is added when missing. '<project>/path' writes into another project. Use instead of title + directory.

title.description: Note title. With `directory`, it also names the file. With `identifier`, it is used when the content has no frontmatter title.

directory.description: Folder for a note addressed by title, e.g. 'meetings'; '/' is the root.

note_type.description: Frontmatter `type:`. A `type:` in the content wins.

metadata.description: Extra frontmatter fields, merged into the note's frontmatter.

overwrite.description: Replace a note that already exists. Default: the write_note_overwrite_default setting (false unless changed).

expected_checksum.description: Replace the note only while it is still this revision (the checksum from bm_read). Implies overwrite=true.

project.description: Required project name, 'workspace/project', or project external id. Discover projects with bm_project(command='list'). Paths are relative to this project; a qualified path must agree with it.
